contract.agent_prompt: Optional string, maximum 4000 characters. Any app may set it; Slackbot receives the prompt when AI is available to the clicking user.
contract.agent_prompt_display: Optional string requiring agent_prompt. Custom collapsed Slackbot text replaces the full prompt; expansion retains the full prompt. Omission uses the button label.
contract.interaction: The app receives block_actions whether or not the click triggers Slackbot, and must acknowledge within three seconds.
contract.unchanged: Optional action_id, button parents and surfaces, URL composition and existing button fields.

library_policy.length_units: Unicode code points, following existing shared text limits.
library_policy.empty_values: No documented minimum: accept empty prompt/display strings. Supplied display requires a supplied prompt even when empty.
library_policy.display_limit: No separate numeric length limit is documented; do not reuse the 75-character button-label limit.

verification.deterministic: Native constructors/builders, supported parsing/editing/serialization paths, shared valid and invalid fixtures across all nine implementations.

live_slack.environment: Original stress-test workspace and test channel; one user without Slackbot AI entitlement.
live_slack.native_payloads: Compiled/executed current guide examples in all nine languages. Their exact native JSON passed standalone and block-only message validation, chat.postMessage, visible rendering and a real browser click.
live_slack.transport: One shared HTTP transport and one authenticated Socket Mode receiver; not nine SDK transport integrations.

callbacks.ack_caveat: Local receipt-to-send timing, not Slack server receipt or round-trip latency. No duplicate delivery or visible Slack error observed.

normalization: Slack adds text.emoji=true; all submitted message values are preserved.
For the empty-value control only, Slack omits both empty prompt fields from the action callback while retaining them in the message. All other action fields match.
validator_discrepancies: blocks.validate rejects top-level message text even for an ordinary-button control. Removing only that envelope field passes; chat.postMessage accepts the full message with text.
blocks.validate accepts agent_prompt_display without agent_prompt. The library retains the stricter dependency in the official button reference.
limitations: Slackbot AI entry offers an upgrade on this workspace. AI routing/execution, custom collapsed display, default-label rendering and prompt expansion remain unverified.
Modal and Home results are structural validation only; no live views were published.
Single workspace/user and current Slack rollout; these observations do not establish behavior for every entitlement or client.
